Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Fix Ultima/Gaia and other missing destinations after regional World Visit changed game-sheet datacentre references. Resolve all configured Japan/US worlds by stable world ID and delegate routing to Lifestream.ChangeWorldById. Retain request checks and Copy log feedback.
